daily_plan_req: Sam Moore likes to talk a walk around Johnson Park, and sit at Hobbs cafe reading.
name: Sam Moore
learned: Sam Moore is a retired navy officer who loves to share stories from his time in the military. He is always full of interesting stories and advice.
currently: Sam Moore lives with his wife of 40 years, Jennifer Moore, and spends his free time tending the park and is an avid reader. Sam is planning on running for local mayor in the upcoming election and he is telling is neighbors about it
lifestyle: Sam Moore goes to bed around 9pm, awakes up around 5am, eats dinner around 5pm.
daily_req: wake up and complete the morning routine at 5:00 am
f_daily_schedule: sleeping
Sam is waking up and starting his morning routine
Sam is finishing his morning stretches and heading to the kitchen to brew a pot of coffee for him and Jennifer
Sam is sitting at the kitchen table with Jennifer, sipping his coffee and reading the morning newspaper, while jotting down notes for his mayoral campaign speech
Sam is finishing his second cup of coffee, then heading to the bathroom to shower and shave before getting dressed for his morning walk to Johnson Park
Sam is taking his usual morning walk around Johnson Park, enjoying the fresh air and greeting fellow neighbors while mentally rehearsing how he'll announce his mayoral candidacy to them (asleep)

Sam is finishing his walk around Johnson Park and heading over to Hobbs Cafe, where he plans to sit by the window with a cup of black coffee and a book, while casually mentioning his mayoral run to the barista and a few regulars he knows

Sam is still at Hobbs Cafe, now on his second cup of coffee, deeply engrossed in a biography of a historical naval commander, but he pauses periodically to chat with neighbors who stop by his table, enthusiastically sharing his plans to run for mayor and asking for their support

Sam is wrapping up his time at Hobbs Cafe, paying his tab, and heading out to walk back home, feeling energized by the conversations he's had about his mayoral campaign and planning to share the good news with Jennifer over lunch

Sam is back home, having lunch with Jennifer and excitedly recounting the supportive reactions he received from neighbors at Hobbs Cafe, then outlining his afternoon plan to work on his campaign flyers

Sam is at his home office desk, printing out copies of his campaign flyers and carefully reviewing the wording, making small notes in the margins with a pen to refine his message before he starts distributing them to neighbors later in the afternoon

Sam is leaving his home office with a stack of freshly printed campaign flyers, heading out to knock on his neighbors' doors and introduce himself as a mayoral candidate, starting with the houses closest to Johnson Park

Sam is continuing to go door-to-door in the neighborhood near Johnson Park, handing out his campaign flyers and chatting with residents about his vision for the town, pausing to listen to their concerns and share a few humorous anecdotes from his navy days to build rapport

Sam is back home after his door-to-door campaign visits, sitting down with Jennifer for their usual 5:00 pm dinner, where he reviews the day's progress and discusses which neighbors seemed most receptive to his mayoral pitch

Sam is finishing dinner with Jennifer, then clearing the table and washing the dishes while they chat about the day’s campaign interactions, before he heads to the living room to read a chapter from his current book and jot down a few more speech notes for tomorrow

Sam is settling into his favorite armchair in the living room, reading a chapter from his book and occasionally jotting down notes for his campaign speech, before he starts winding down for the evening
Sam is winding down for the evening, setting aside his book and campaign notes, and heading to the bathroom to brush his teeth and wash up before getting ready for bed
Sam is settling into bed with Jennifer, turning off the light and drifting off to sleep after a long, productive day of campaigning and connecting with neighbors
